thread:
marta: Starting coordination for tonight's cross-service rollout window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Target artifacts: api v2.5.0, runtime v2.5.0-quant, router v2.5.0, console v2.5.0-ui. Sequence proposal: router -> runtime -> api -> console. We'll pin-by-default and unpin only after full success. Thoughts?

ryan: +1 on sequence. Router change includes new header rewrite for X-RI-Client. Must ensure runtime handler accepts Legacy and New formats.

kevin: runtime has a compatibility mode flag (header.mode=dual). We'll enable it for canary but prefer to disable global until api is updated.

sam: ops: auto-rollback rules: errors >0.7% sustained 4m OR p95 latency +80ms sustained 5m triggers rollback. Also manual console hold if visual diffs >2% fail.

deploy-bot: deploybot: created rollout job (marta). Phase A: router -> v2.5.0 to 1% slice eu-central-1.

ops-bot: metric: router 1% slice stable. p95 +2ms, errors 0.01%.

kevin: enabling runtime header.mode=dual in infra-config now, will roll restarts in low-impact batch.

deploy-bot: deploybot: runtime -> v2.5.0-quant canary 1% (eu-central-1).

ops-bot: runtime canary metrics: CPU +9%, p99 +6ms, errors 0.1%. No OOMs. KV hit-rate normal.

marta: good, proceed with api 1% but keep api logs verbose for header parsing.

deploy-bot: deploybot: api -> v2.5.0 canary 1% (global).

qa-bot: smoke: api 1% sample: 4/50 requests returned 500 with header parse error. Stack traces show runtime throwing on malformed cookie.

ryan: that's concerning. Are those from old clients or the router rewrite?

kevin: logs show router is sending new X-RI-Client but runtime in dual mode still failing for a subset due to cookie parsing. I can push a quick runtime microfix to tolerate empty cookie string.

marta: do we have time for a hotfix? Sam, what's your rollback recommendation?

sam: given error spike ~8% in that 1% slice for those endpoints, and it's parsing related, I'd prefer to rollback api canary to v2.4.9 until microfix is live. Matches rollback rule (errors >0.7% sustained).

marta: agreed. Rollback api canary. Hold console promotions. Keep runtime dual-mode to avoid further regressions.

deploy-bot: deploybot: api rollback -> pinned to v2.4.9, canary terminated.

ops-bot: api 1% rollback done. error-rate back to baseline.

kevin: I'll prepare runtime microfix branch now (cookie-tolerate). Should be a small change, quick review requested.

marta: timeline: aim to merge and redeploy api + runtime within 30-40m. If microfix succeeds, we retry api 1% then scale. Update release notes with incident.

ryan: also will add a router fallback that emits legacy header for a small % if parity issues persist.

kevin: microfix PR up: https://go/pr/RI-1250. Assigning to ryan for quick review.

qa-bot: regression suite queued against staging with new runtime build.

marta: thanks. Everyone stand by for reattempt. Keep monitoring channels for ops alerts.

sam: watching infra metrics and will call emergency pinback if we see sustained anomalies.

marta: also note: console UI feature flag for new header display remains off (feature.console.header=true). We'll not promote console until api is fully green.

kevin: merged, starting runtime canary redeploy to 1% now.

ops-bot: runtime redeploy metrics: canary healthy, errors 0.02%, p95 stable.

deploy-bot: deploybot: api redeploy -> v2.5.0 canary 1% (global). Verbose logs enabled.

ops-bot: api canary: initial 10m show zero header parse 500s. Error-rate 0.03%.

marta: excellent. Proceed to 5% for router/runtime, keep api at 1% for 10m then 5% if stable. Console remain at 1% smoke only.

deploy-bot: deploybot: promoting router/runtime to 5% now. Scheduled api to 5% after 10m stable.

sam: monitoring. No alert conditions tripped.

marta: adding note to release doc: RI-1250 hotfix, runtime cookie tolerate, api retried. Marking api pin cleared once 20% stable for 20m.

kevin: thanks all. We'll keep header.mode documented for next deploy batch.
